# Frankfurt Expat Services

Frankfurt Expat Services helps international residents settle in Frankfurt with practical guides, free account tools, a curated provider directory, a public-read forum, and clearly labelled partner offers.

## Core Pages
- [Frankfurt Expat Services](/): Free Frankfurt relocation tools, checklists, guides, forum access, and curated English-speaking service providers.
- [Frankfurt First 30 Days Checklist](/frankfurt-first-30-days-checklist): A practical first-month setup checklist for Anmeldung, tax ID, bank account, health insurance, housing, and everyday Frankfurt tasks.
- [Frankfurt Expat Service Directory](/directory): Curated English-speaking tax, housing, banking, immigration, insurance, and healthcare providers for Frankfurt newcomers.
- [Free Frankfurt Expat Tools](/tools): Free account tools for Frankfurt newcomers: tax calculator, currency converter, QR code generator, password generator, and checklist access.
- [Recommended Frankfurt Expat Partner Offers](/partners): Clearly labelled referral partner offers for banking and investing services that may help Frankfurt expats during setup.
- [Frankfurt Apartment Finder](/apartments): A housing search hub with original portal links, neighborhood notes, and scam checks without copying third-party listings.
- [Frankfurt Expat Forum](/forum): Public Frankfurt expat discussions with signup required to post or reply.
- [Frankfurt Expat Guides](/blog): Practical relocation guides for Anmeldung, housing, tax, health insurance, banking, visa, and first-month setup.

## Directory Categories
- [English-Speaking Tax Advisors in Frankfurt](/directory/tax-advisors-frankfurt): Find vetted English-speaking tax advisors and Steuerberater in Frankfurt for expats. Specialists in income tax returns, tax class advice, US/UK dual filing, and cross-border obligations.
- [Relocation Agents & Housing Support in Frankfurt](/directory/housing-relocation-frankfurt): Find English-speaking relocation agents and housing support services in Frankfurt. Specialists in apartment sourcing, Mietvertrag review, landlord negotiations, and temporary housing for expats.
- [Banking & Financial Advisors for Frankfurt Expats](/directory/banking-financial-advisors-frankfurt): Find English-speaking independent financial advisors in Frankfurt for expats. Specialists in cross-border pension planning, ETF investments, German bank account setup, and insurance gap analysis.
- [Immigration Lawyers & Visa Support in Frankfurt](/directory/immigration-lawyers-frankfurt): Find English-speaking immigration lawyers in Frankfurt for expats. Specialists in Blue Card applications, family reunification, Niederlassungserlaubnis, work permits, and document legalisation.
- [English-Speaking Insurance Brokers in Frankfurt](/directory/insurance-brokers-frankfurt): Find English-speaking insurance brokers in Frankfurt for expats. Specialists in private vs statutory health insurance, Haftpflicht liability, Hausrat contents cover, and life insurance.
- [English-Speaking Doctors & Healthcare in Frankfurt](/directory/english-speaking-doctors-frankfurt): Find English-speaking GPs, dentists, therapists, and specialists in Frankfurt. Healthcare providers experienced with international patients, expat insurance, and multilingual consultations.

## Tool Landing Pages
- [German Income Tax Calculator for Frankfurt Expats](/tools/german-tax-calculator-frankfurt): Free German income tax calculator for Frankfurt expats. Estimate net salary after Lohnsteuer, Solidaritätszuschlag, and social insurance. Useful for salary negotiations and budget planning.
- [Currency Converter for Frankfurt Expats](/tools/currency-converter-frankfurt): Free currency converter for Frankfurt expats using live ECB reference rates. Convert GBP, USD, CHF, and other currencies to EUR for salary comparisons, rent budgeting, and cost planning.
- [Free QR Code Generator](/tools/qr-code-generator): Free browser-based QR code generator for signed-in users. Create QR codes for URLs, contact cards, and text with no watermarks. Useful for Frankfurt expats sharing contact details and links.
- [Secure Password Generator](/tools/password-generator): Free secure password generator. Create strong random passwords for German government portals, banking, and insurance accounts. Runs entirely in your browser — no data sent to servers.

- [Freelancer tax basics in Frankfurt](/blog/freelancer-tax-basics-frankfurt): An overview of German tax obligations for freelancers (Freiberufler) and the self-employed in Frankfurt — from registration to quarterly payments.
- [Tax return deadlines in Germany: what Frankfurt expats must know](/blog/german-tax-return-deadlines): Key Steuererklärung deadlines, what happens if you miss them, and how a Steuerberater extends your filing window.
- [Church tax in Germany: what expats need to know](/blog/church-tax-germany-expats): How Kirchensteuer works, who it applies to, how to deregister if relevant, and the financial impact on your Frankfurt payslip.
- [Public vs private health insurance in Germany: an expat guide](/blog/public-vs-private-health-insurance-germany): The key differences between GKV and PKV for Frankfurt expats — coverage, cost, dependants, switching rules, and how to choose.
- [Haftpflicht insurance explained for Frankfurt expats](/blog/haftpflicht-insurance-germany): Why personal liability insurance (Haftpflicht) is essential in Germany, what it covers, what it costs, and how to get it quickly after arriving.

- [Preparing for your Frankfurt Ausländerbehörde appointment](/blog/residence-permit-appointment-frankfurt): What to bring, what to expect, and how to prepare for your residence permit appointment at Frankfurt's foreigners' authority.
- [Family reunification in Germany: basics for Frankfurt expats](/blog/family-reunification-germany-basics): Bringing a spouse or children to Frankfurt — income requirements, language requirements, application steps, and how long it takes.
